title: QR Vault import regression eval
description: Ranks three agent attempts for one concrete repo task: keep QR Vault import/export collection membership correct, verified, and scoped.

task.prompt: In apps/qr-vault, fix import/export so collection membership survives both Merge and Replace. Add focused regression coverage and report the commands used to verify the fix.
expectedOutcome: Imported QR entries keep their collection memberships after Merge and Replace.
Malformed import payloads are rejected without overwriting local vault data.
Regression tests cover import/export round trips with collections.
The response includes fresh test/build evidence or clearly explains any skipped check.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Does the attempt satisfy the task contract and handle the important edge cases?

rubric.label: Verification
rubric.description: Does it include focused regression tests and fresh command evidence?

rubric.label: Repo fit
rubric.description: Does it use existing QR Vault data shapes and project commands?

rubric.label: Scope control
rubric.description: Does it avoid unrelated rewrites, styling churn, and speculative features?

attempts.title: Attempt A - parser-only patch
attempts.brief: Touches the import parser and reports one manual smoke check.
attempts.output: Adds a fallback when collectionIds are missing, but does not test Replace and does not prove malformed payload safety.

evidence.correctness: Preserves some imported memberships, but misses Replace and invalid payload behavior.
evidence.verification: Only mentions a manual browser check; no regression test or build output.
evidence.repo_fit: Uses the existing import parser and vault shape.
evidence.scope: Patch stays local to import code.

attempts.title: Attempt B - test-first round trip
attempts.brief: Adds round-trip coverage, fixes Merge and Replace, and keeps changes inside QR Vault import logic.
attempts.output: Introduces a focused collection-membership regression test, fixes the serializer/importer mismatch, and verifies test plus build.

evidence.correctness: Covers Merge, Replace, and malformed payload behavior from the task.
evidence.verification: Includes focused Vitest coverage and fresh build evidence.
evidence.repo_fit: Reuses the existing vault model and app-level pnpm filter commands.
evidence.scope: No unrelated UI, dependency, or formatting churn.

attempts.title: Attempt C - import wizard rewrite
attempts.brief: Reworks the import screen while fixing the happy path.
attempts.output: Makes the flow clearer and fixes the sample export, but changes layout and copy without covering invalid payloads.

evidence.correctness: Happy-path membership survives, but malformed payload handling is still unclear.
evidence.verification: Adds one UI-oriented test and skips build.
evidence.repo_fit: Mostly follows existing components, but adds a new flow for a data bug.
evidence.scope: Visual rewrite is larger than the reported regression needs.
